commits.title: Add Christmas-themed login enhancements and tests
commits.before_text: Christmas login effects and light/dark transitions used the earlier effect-state and animation handling.
commits.after_text: Refines Christmas login styling, festive interactions and light/dark transitions across the login and shared theme scripts. Adds regression coverage for login effects, theme behavior and liquid-glass interactions.

comparisons.title: Seasonal sign-in — desktop
comparisons.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen with the seasonal theme selected.
comparisons.after_text: The updated sign-in screen with the same theme selected. This static view does not show animation.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe login-layout. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic blocked. Only the historical decoration script rendered a reduced-motion frame.

comparisons.title: Seasonal sign-in — mobile
comparisons.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen on a narrow viewport.
comparisons.after_text: The updated sign-in screen on the same narrow viewport.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe login-layout. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic blocked. Only the historical decoration script rendered a reduced-motion frame.

commits.title: Enhance profile card layout and avatar upload functionality
commits.before_text: The profile avatar card and upload controls used the previous layout and markup.
commits.after_text: Reorganizes the profile avatar card, upload controls and supporting styles for clearer responsive profile editing.

comparisons.title: Profile avatar controls — mobile
comparisons.before_text: Profile Avatar occupied its own tab and card.
comparisons.after_text: Profile Avatar is now a section within Personal Information. The same synthetic account has no uploaded photo.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe profile-avatar. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic blocked. Page scripts disabled.
